card.name: Physician's judgment or discretion phrases
card.fires_on: The words judgment or discretion, and the "of" right after them, in phrases leaving a decision to the treating clinician. The next words are usually "the physician" or "the healthcare provider".

modes.label: Judgment/discretion noun
modes.description: The noun judgment or discretion itself, before "of the physician".
modes.example: Dexamethasone can be tapered according to the<< judgment>> of the treating physician [see Clinical Studies

modes.label: "of" after the noun
modes.description: The word "of" following discretion or judgment, just before the clinician is named.
modes.example: the infusion may be slowed, or stopped and restarted at a slower rate, at the discretion<< of>> the physician.

card.writes: Promotes odd word-start tokens with no clear link, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on phrases like "at the discretion of the physician" that leave a decision to the clinician.
